candidate_concepts: 1. spread level at signal birth (zero window/baseline DOF)
2. pre-birth spread expansion (needs a baseline window)
3. pre-birth spread compression (needs a baseline window)
4. spread change relative to a prior baseline (needs a baseline window + ratio-vs-difference-vs-log choice)
5. past-only normalized spread state / z-score (needs lookback + expanding-vs-rolling + min-obs + cold-start sub-contract)
6. spread persistence or reversion (needs a window + persistence metric)
spread_feature_children.recommended_leading_option: the family's own named concept is a windowed CHANGE (expansion/compression), so the leading candidate is a single spread-ratio expansion: spread_bps(T) vs spread_bps(T-W) as a log-ratio; the minimal zero-DOF fallback is concept 1 (spread level at birth)
spread_feature_children.why_not_frozen_here: concepts 2-6 all require at minimum a baseline-window choice, and concepts 4-5 additionally require a feature-FORM choice (ratio vs log-ratio vs difference vs z-score) and (for 5) a full normalization sub-contract -- none of which is resolvable outcome-blind; per the batch instructions, the exact candidate set is presented and an operator ruling is requested rather than choosing arbitrarily

window_audit.window_invariance_reason: book_ticker updates sub-second continuously, so a fresh quote exists at T-W whenever one exists at T -- coverage cannot differentiate windows, removing the one outcome-blind tiebreaker that resolved absorption's W300

duplicate_ts_ms.resolution: deterministic id-DESC tie-break in the frozen quote-selection rule

family_distinctness.physical_mechanism: instantaneous quoted liquidity thinness -- how far apart the best bid and best ask are on the L1 book
family_distinctness.what_it_does_not_measure: executed flow (CVD), price impact per flow (absorption), queued depth quantity (book-pull/refill), funding rate, single-instrument trend, or a two-market price relationship (basis)
family_distinctness.why_not_volatility: spread is an instantaneous cross-sectional price gap between two live quotes, not a time-series dispersion of returns
family_distinctness.why_not_trend: spread is directionless (a magnitude of bid-ask separation), not a signed price movement
family_distinctness.why_not_order_flow_imbalance: spread uses no trade/taker-side information at all -- only resting best quotes
family_distinctness.why_not_renamed_absorption: absorption is price response PER UNIT of executed signed flow (a ratio driven by trades); spread uses zero trade data and measures quoted-liquidity width, a distinct liquidity-state channel

verdict_meaning: the DATA is ready (NOT blocked by coverage: 97 cycles, TEST~30 >= MIN_BUCKET_N=20; NOT blocked by source quality: exact L1, 0 crossed/locked/zero at anchors, 2ms median staleness, duplicate-ts resolved deterministically) -- but the family's named concept (expansion/compression = a windowed CHANGE relative to a baseline) has multiple defensible feature forms AND a baseline-window that cannot be selected outcome-blind (coverage is window-invariant), so one operator ruling on feature-form + window is required before disposable rehearsal
blockers: DEFINITION: feature form (level vs expansion-ratio vs log-ratio vs difference vs z-score) is unresolved and not selectable outcome-blind

WINDOW: the baseline window for any change feature is coverage-indistinguishable across {60,300,600,1800,3600}s -- no outcome-blind tiebreaker exists (unlike absorption's W300, which had a defensible mechanism/comparability rationale that here applies equally to all windows)
NOT a data blocker: coverage (97 cycles) and source quality (exact, clean) are both sufficient
